value: Joyfill npm supply-chain compromise (StepSecurity, 2026-07-28). Malicious '2773' beta versions of @joyfill/components and @joyfill/layouts carry an obfuscated payload injected only into the built dist bundles (no source change, no package.json install hook). The payload runs ON IMPORT, so npm install --ignore-scripts does NOT stop it. Five-stage in-memory chain: obfuscated loader -> blockchain dead-drop C2 resolver (Tron -> BNB Smart Chain -> Aptos fallback) -> two staged downloaders -> Socket.IO RAT with npm-CLI worm self-propagation + a Python credential stealer. Unattributed; the shared implant across both packages indicates one actor. No CVE (a package compromise, not a software vulnerability).
